Welcome, Our Dearest Guests

A note before the details — please read this first.

Welcome, and thank you for coming — some of you from across Norway, some from much further. We met in Oslo, and we are getting married where the city meets the water, in the long light of a Nordic summer evening.

Everything you need is on this page: times, addresses, where to stay, what to wear, and the RSVP at the bottom. If anything is unclear, message us. We would rather answer twice than have you guess once.

— Emma & Liam

Our Story

How we met, and how we got here — in four moments.

2019 — Oslo University

We met over a borrowed textbook

Emma had the only copy of the reading list. Liam borrowed it, returned it three weeks late, and apologised with coffee. The coffee became a habit, then a friendship.

2020–2023 — The Fjord Walks

Weekends got longer

Every free Saturday became a walk — first around the city, then out to the fjords. Liam proposed the route; Emma proposed the picnic. Neither remembers who first said the word future.

December 2026 — By the Water

He asked at sunset

On a cold, clear evening by the fjord, Liam asked properly, with both families on a video call afterwards. Emma said yes, then made him ask again so her sister could hear it.

19 June 2027 — Today, With You

Now we want you in the room

Midsummer light, a manor by the water, and the people who made us who we are. That is the whole plan — and the only thing missing is you.

Venue, Travel & Stay

Flying in? Start here, then pick a hotel that fits your budget.

The Venue

Fjordview Manor, Oslo — our recommended base if you want one place for the whole celebration.

Open in Google Maps →

Getting Here

Oslo Gardermoen Airport (OSL) is the nearest airport. Allow about 45 minutes by car to the manor in normal traffic — book your ride in advance for the main evening.

Parking & Shuttle

Parking is available at the venue where noted in the FAQ. There is no arranged shuttle between hotels, so please plan a ride for each evening and pre-book for late returns.

Where to Stay

Price bands are indicative for planning only — please confirm live rates when you book.

Budget — city hostels & guesthousesIndicative band: lower nightly rates. Central Oslo, easy tram to the venue area.
Mid-range — Clarion Hotel OsloIndicative band: mid nightly rates. Central, a short taxi ride from Fjordview Manor.
Premium — Fjordview Manor (venue hotel)Indicative band: higher nightly rates. Stay where the wedding is — no travel on the day itself.

Travelling with children or elderly family? Tell us in the RSVP message and we will help you choose the most comfortable option.

A Note on Gifts

Your presence is the gift — truly. If you still wish to give, a contribution towards our honeymoon is welcome, and we will share details personally with anyone who asks. There is no online registry or payment link on this page, by design.

— — —

Questions, Answered

Tap a question to open it.

Yes — children are welcome. Please include them in your guest count so we can seat and cater for them. The welcome evening is the most relaxed night for families.

Only if your invitation names a plus-one, or you have confirmed one with us directly. If unsure, write it in the RSVP message and we will confirm — seating is planned by name.

Limited parking at the manor; we recommend the tram or a taxi. If you drive, arrive early — the car park fills by 3:30 PM.

Smart formal, light colours. Avoid trainers and very dark formal wear in the June light; comfortable shoes are wise for the terrace and dancing.

No gift is expected — your presence is the gift. If you wish to give, a honeymoon contribution is welcome; ask us personally for details.

June in Oslo is mild but changeable — bring a light layer for the evening terrace. The ceremony is indoors if it rains; the terrace is stone, so block heels are fine.
